# Tyber.io

> Small engineering team for sites, apps and infrastructure, in any language or stack.
> We understand the problem before proposing a solution, and the person you talk to is the
> person doing the work. Based in São Paulo, Brazil, working remotely for Brazil and abroad,
> in Portuguese (pt-BR) and English.

How we work: reply within 1 business day, scope in writing before any work starts, no
lock-in (code, access and accounts stay in the client's name, with a runbook), nothing
destructive without the client's approval, and we start from what the client already has
instead of rewriting it.

WordPress is one of the platforms we run the most, not the only offer: the stack follows the
problem (Next.js, Astro, mobile apps, APIs, cloud infrastructure, applied AI).

## Languages and URL structure

- Portuguese (pt-BR) lives at the root and English under `/en/`, with the same slug in both
  trees and `hreflang` on every page. The root (Portuguese) is the `x-default`.
- There is no redirect by geography or browser language: the URL is the language. Quote the
  page in the language of the person asking.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tyber.io/): what we do and how to start a conversation. English: [/en/](https://tyber.io/en/)
- [About](https://tyber.io/about/): how we work, the five areas, the stack we operate and the FAQ. English: [/en/about/](https://tyber.io/en/about/)
- [Contact](https://tyber.io/contact/): WhatsApp and a form; describe the problem, reply within 1 business day. English: [/en/contact/](https://tyber.io/en/contact/)
- [Solutions index](https://tyber.io/solutions/): every service on one page. English: [/en/solutions/](https://tyber.io/en/solutions/)
- [Portfolio](https://tyber.io/portfolio/): anonymized case studies. English: [/en/portfolio/](https://tyber.io/en/portfolio/)

## Services

- [Sites](https://tyber.io/solutions/sites/): landing pages, editorial portals, documentation sites and headless commerce, in the stack that fits.
- [DevOps](https://tyber.io/solutions/devops/): cloud, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and Kubernetes, on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, DigitalOcean, Hetzner and Cloudflare.
- [Observability](https://tyber.io/solutions/observability/): monitoring on Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo and OpenTelemetry, with AI-assisted triage.
- [Security](https://tyber.io/solutions/security/): hardening, access control, secrets management and LGPD/GDPR-aware design.
- [Automation](https://tyber.io/solutions/automation/): workflow automation and integrations, with AI where fixed rules are not enough.
- [Bots](https://tyber.io/solutions/bot/): conversational bots on Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Discord or Teams, with answers grounded in the client's own knowledge.

## Case studies (anonymized)

Each case describes sector, scale, stack and what was measured before and after. No client is named.

- [Edge DDoS mitigation under election-cycle load](https://tyber.io/portfolio/edge-ddos-mitigation/)
- [Cutting CDN spend without breaking the reader experience](https://tyber.io/portfolio/finops-publisher-cdn/)
- [Lighthouse 100 on a high-volume regional news portal](https://tyber.io/portfolio/regional-news-perf/)
- [Multi-tenant WordPress restore pipeline](https://tyber.io/portfolio/wp-restore-automation/)

## Machine-readable data

- Every page carries Schema.org JSON-LD: `ProfessionalService` (`https://tyber.io/#organization`)
  and `WebSite` (`https://tyber.io/#website`). /about/ adds `AboutPage` and `FAQPage`;
  /contact/ adds a `Person`. Inner pages carry a `BreadcrumbList`.
- The site is static HTML: all text is in the initial response and no JavaScript is needed
  to read it.
- [Sitemap (both languages)](https://tyber.io/sitemap.xml)

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://tyber.io/privacy/) and [Terms of service](https://tyber.io/terms/)
- [news.tyber.io](https://news.tyber.io/): a bilingual tech news portal (AI, code, hardware and games), operated by Tyber.io as its own product. It is a separate property with its own advertising; tyber.io carries no third-party advertising.

## How to cite this site

Prefer the page that owns the subject: a service question belongs to the matching
/solutions/ URL, a question about how we work belongs to /about/, and a question about
results belongs to the matching /portfolio/ case. When attributing, use "Tyber.io".

## What not to infer

- No client is ever named. Work is described by sector, scale and stack.
- No project or client count is published. Any "N+ projects delivered" number attributed to
  Tyber.io did not come from this site.
- Anything not linked from this file should not be treated as an active offering.
